scoring.caveat: scores are analyst judgments for prioritization, not measured demand, conversion, revenue or churn

opportunities.name: Conteúdo Pronto setorial
opportunities.target: MEIs and small local businesses that sell through WhatsApp and social networks but lack time or process for weekly communication
opportunities.offer: keep the existing monthly package: 12 posts, 4 WhatsApp sales messages and a 30-day calendar, adapted to the business segment; customer remains responsible for approval and publication
opportunities.differentiation: Brazilian Portuguese, small-business context, segment adaptation and no account custody or promise of sales

delivery_cost_estimate.required_measurement: three internal dry runs recording machine usage and human review minutes before any commercial test

opportunities.retention_hypothesis: medium_high_if_each_month_is genuinely specific and saves preparation time
opportunities.cancellation_risk: medium_high: generic output, publication effort, seasonality and free AI alternatives
infrastructure_reuse: Conteúdo Pronto page and declared fulfillment

opportunities.name: Rotina de follow-up para WhatsApp
opportunities.target: owner-operated businesses that sell by messaging and lose track of next actions
opportunities.offer: weekly follow-up board, prioritized next-action prompts and reusable message variants; no message sending, contact storage or WhatsApp API in the initial concept
opportunities.differentiation: lighter than a CRM and designed for one owner-operator; guidance rather than account integration

delivery_cost_estimate.required_measurement: prototype generation timing without customer data or WhatsApp integration

opportunities.cancellation_risk: high: free CRM availability, manual upkeep, WhatsApp policy/integration expectations

opportunities.name: Caixa em Dia
opportunities.target: MEIs and small businesses that need a short recurring cash routine but are not ready for a full financial SaaS
opportunities.offer: weekly cash checklist, monthly closing guide and interpretation prompts built around customer-entered aggregate totals; no bank access and no financial execution
opportunities.differentiation: short routine and educational interpretation between a free spreadsheet and a full financial system

delivery_cost_estimate.qualitative: low_for_static_guidance; higher and privacy-sensitive if data ingestion or human review is introduced
delivery_cost_estimate.required_measurement: zero-data prototype and task-time measurement; no customer financial data

opportunities.frequency: daily entries, weekly review and monthly closing
opportunities.cancellation_risk: high: habit fatigue, free spreadsheets, full SaaS competition and trust requirements

recommendation.reason: it is the only shortlisted recurring offer already represented in the catalog and fulfillment description, has direct recurring communication demand signals, and requires validation rather than another product build
non_claims: R$197 is not proven willingness to pay
retention and delivery margin are unknown
market percentages do not predict ZEVANORY conversion

demand_test_without_charge.audience: qualified visitors already arriving at free sector guides or existing organic channels
demand_test_without_charge.treatment: unpublished interest page or mockup describing the existing monthly deliverables and the R$197 hypothetical validation price
demand_test_without_charge.collection_rule: aggregate counts only; no payment and no personal data required for the initial click test
demand_test_without_charge.success_criterion: pre-register a threshold before launch; do not set it from observed results
stop_conditions: support or generation cost cannot be measured

recommendation.next_decision: only after demand and dry-run cost evidence, decide whether to keep, narrow by segment, reprice or reject
